scope: Node-only model and static resource verification. No browser QA.

results.name: Initial model, IDs, HP, inventory and PP satisfy invariant checks
Potion caps at max HP and stock commits once; repeat full-HP use is inert
Full HP, fainted, unknown target, unsupported effect, zero stock are inert
Tonic heals ten capped and decrements only its own stock
Attack at one PP spends once, deals declared damage and gets one response
No PP changes no HP/stock/PP/turn; message opening and cancellation are inert
Killing blow skips enemy response, terminal battle blocks further damage
Battle medicine commits one heal, one stock, one turn and one enemy response
Switch rejects current/FNT; living reserve becomes active and receives response
Zero active HP marks FNT and blocks moves until valid switch
Last living member fainting produces loss and suppresses later actions
First Run fails with one response; second escapes with no response
canEscape=false always fails, taking exactly one response each time
Source/local runtime paths resolve; no remote runtime requests
Copied font, CSS, both PNGs and original licenses match frozen input SHA-256
PNG dimensions/indexed transparency match source atlas contract
